scanNote: 12-mashqda ikkita uzunlik javobi bor: 'About 3.3 metres' va 'About 3.1 metres'. Fil bo'yi tanasidan uzun bo'lishi mumkin emasligi uchun kattarog'i (3.3) BO'YIga, kichigi (3.1) XARTUMga to'g'ri keladi. Bu mantiqiy yechim, kitobda javob kaliti berilmagan.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the questions and match them to the answers.
exercises.instructionUz: Savollarga qarang va ularni javoblarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ROQ SO'ZLARI — TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  WHAT ......... nima?          — narsa, hayvon, ish
  WHERE ........ qayerda?       — joy
  WHEN ......... qachon?        — vaqt
  WHY .......... nega?          — sabab (javob: Because ...)
  WHO .......... kim?           — odam
  WHOSE ........ kimniki?       — egalik
  HOW .......... qanday?        — usul
  HOW LONG ..... qancha uzun? / qancha vaqt?
  HOW TALL ..... qancha baland?
  HOW MUCH ..... qancha? (og'irlik, narx — sanalmaydigan)
  HOW MANY ..... nechta? (sanaladigan)

DIQQAT — 'HOW LONG' IKKI MA'NODA:
  How long is its trunk?   → UZUNLIK (metr)
  How long does it live?   → DAVOMIYLIK (yil)
Qaysi ma'noda ekanini fe'ldan bilib olasiz.

DIQQAT — 'HOW MUCH' vs 'HOW MANY':
  How MUCH does it weigh?      → kilo (sanalmaydi)
  How MANY legs has it got?    → nechta (sanaladi)

SAVOL TUZILISHI (Present Simple, 'it' ega):
  So'roq so'zi + DOES + it + fe'l (asos shakli) + ?
     Where DOES it LIVE?   ('lives' XATO — 'does' bor)
  'be' va 'have got' bilan 'does' KERAK EMAS:
     What IS this animal?   How tall IS it?
     How many legs HAS it got?

pairs.whyUz: 'What' — nima? Javob: hayvon nomi. 'be' bilan 'does' kerak emas.

pairs.right: On the plains in Africa and India.
pairs.whyUz:
'Where' — qayerda? Javob joy predlogi bilan boshlanadi: ON the plains.
'plains' = tekisliklar, dashtlar.
'When' — qachon? Javob vaqt ifodasi: AT night.

pairs.left: WHY can it walk long distances?
pairs.right: Because it has got strong legs.
pairs.leftUz: Nega u uzoq masofaga yura oladi?
pairs.whyUz:
'Why' — nega? Javob DOIM 'Because' bilan boshlanadi.
'a distance' = masofa.

'How long' bu yerda UZUNLIK. 'a trunk' = xartum.
Qolgan ikki uzunlikdan KICHIGI xartumga tegishli — chunki hayvon bo'yidan uzun tana qismi bo'lmaydi.
'How tall' — bo'y. Fil taxminan 3,3 metr balandlikda — bu eng katta o'lcham.

'How much' — og'irlik (sanalmaydi). Fil quruqlikdagi eng og'ir hayvon.
DIQQAT: inglizchada mingliklar VERGUL bilan ajratiladi: 4,000.

pairs.left: HOW many legs has it got?
pairs.whyUz: 'How many' — sanaladigan narsa. 'has it got' — 'does' kerak emas.

'How long' bu yerda DAVOMIYLIK — chunki fe'l 'live'.
Bu 42-betdagi viktorinaning 9-gapi bilan bir xil fakt.

exercises.explanationUz:
Bu matn — LOYIHA UCHUN NAMUNA.
43-betning o'ng tomonidagi yozma ish (yo'lbars va dengiz sheri haqida)
shu matn tuzilishi bo'yicha yoziladi.

MATN TARTIBI:
  1) turi        — Kangaroos are mammals.
  2) bolasi      — They have babies and feed them on milk.
  3) joyi        — They live in Australia.
  4) o'lchami    — about two metres tall, weigh about sixty kilos
  5) tanasi      — two back legs, two short front legs, a long tail
  6) qobiliyati  — They can jump very high because ...
  7) odati       — They sleep during the day.
  8) ovqati      — they eat leaves
  9) bolasi      — carry their babies in a pouch
 10) guruhi      — They live in small groups.
 11) umri        — They live for about fifteen to twenty years.

sentences.noteUz: Turkumlash: ega ham, guruh ham KO'PLIKDA.

sentences.en: They have babies and feed them on milk.
sentences.uz: Ular bola tug'adi va ularni sut bilan boqadi.

sentences.en: They are about two metres tall and weigh about sixty kilos.
sentences.uz: Ularning bo'yi taxminan ikki metr va og'irligi taxminan oltmish kilo.
sentences.noteUz:
Bo'y: 'be ... metres TALL' (tall OXIRIDA).
Og'irlik: 'weigh ... kilos' — 'be' KERAK EMAS.

sentences.en: Kangaroos have got two back legs, two short front legs and a long tail.
sentences.uz: Kengurularning ikkita orqa oyog'i, ikkita kalta old oyog'i va uzun dumi bor.
sentences.noteUz: Sanashda oxirgisidan oldin 'and' qo'yiladi, qolgani vergul bilan.

sentences.en: They can jump very high because their back legs are very strong.
sentences.uz: Ular juda baland sakray oladi, chunki orqa oyoqlari juda kuchli.
sentences.noteUz:
'because' sabab bog'lovchisi — ikki gapni bog'laydi.
'high' bu yerda RAVISH: 'jump high' ('highly' XATO).

sentences.en: They sleep during the day and they eat leaves.
sentences.uz: Ular kunduzi uxlaydi va barg yeydi.

sentences.en: Kangaroos carry their babies in a pouch.
sentences.noteUz: 'a pouch' = xalta. Faqat kenguru, koala kabi hayvonlarda bor.

sentences.en: They live for about fifteen to twenty years.
sentences.uz: Ular taxminan o'n beshdan yigirma yilgacha yashaydi.
sentences.noteUz: Oraliq: 'from ... to ...' o'rniga qisqa shakl 'fifteen TO twenty'.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, in pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the table above.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng juftlikda yuqoridagi jadval bo'yicha savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
12-mashqdagi savollarni kenguruga moslab so'rang.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: What is this animal?
  SB: It's a kangaroo. ...

Har bir javobni matndan toping.

items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna javob.
Matnda: 'They live in Australia.'
Matnda: 'They sleep during the day.' Fil kechasi uxlaydi, kenguru esa kunduzi.

items.textEn: Why can it jump very high?
items.answer: Because its back legs are very strong.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'because their back legs are very strong'.
Birlik ('it') haqida gapirganda 'their' → 'its'.
Matnda: 'They are about two metres tall.'
Matnda: 'weigh about sixty kilos'.

items.textEn: How many legs has it got?
items.whyUz: Ikkita orqa + ikkita old = to'rtta.
Matnda: 'they eat leaves'. Koala ham barg yeydi (42-bet).
Matnda: 'They live for about fifteen to twenty years.'

items.textEn: What can it do very well?
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'They can jump very high'.

items.textEn: Where does it carry its babies?
items.whyUz: Matnda: 'Kangaroos carry their babies in a pouch.'

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and the information about these animals and ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga va bu hayvonlar haqidagi ma'lumotga qarang, namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
MA'LUMOT VARAQLARIDA SAVOLLAR QISQARTIRILGAN:
  ...this animal?  → What is this animal?
  ...weigh?        → How much does it weigh?
  ...eat?          → What does it eat?
  ...sleep?        → When does it sleep?
  ...live?         → Where does it live?  (joy)
  ...live?         → How long does it live?  (umr)
  ...can/do?       → What can it do?

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  S1: What is this animal?
  S2: It's a tiger. How much does it weigh?
  S3: It weighs about 200 kilos. What does it eat?...

DIQQAT: har bir o'quvchi javob beradi VA keyingi savolni beradi.

items.question: What is this animal?
items.whyUz: Hayvon nomini so'rash — 'What is ...?' ('does' kerak emas).

items.question: How much does it weigh?
items.whyUz: Og'irlik → 'How much'. Javobda fe'lga -s: weighS.

items.question: What does it eat?
items.whyUz: Ma'lumot varaqasidan: deer and monkeys. 'deer' ko'plikda ham 'deer'.

items.question: When does it sleep?
items.whyUz: Vaqt → 'When'. Ma'lumot varaqasidan: during the day.

items.question: Where does it live?
items.answer: It lives in the forests in India.
items.whyUz: Joy → 'Where'. Ma'lumot varaqasidan: forests in India.

items.question: How long does it live?
items.whyUz: Umr → 'How long'. 'live FOR' — 'for' shart.

items.question: What is this animal?
items.whyUz: 'a sea lion' — dengiz sheri, sutemizuvchi.

items.question: How much does it weigh?
items.whyUz: Ma'lumot varaqasidan: about 250 kilos — yo'lbarsdan og'irroq.

items.question: What does it eat?
items.whyUz: Ma'lumot varaqasidan: fish. Delfin va pingvin ham baliq yeydi.

items.question: What can it do?
items.whyUz: Qobiliyat → 'can'. 'can' dan keyin fe'l asos shaklida.

items.question: Where does it live?
items.answer: It lives in the Pacific Ocean.
items.whyUz: Okean nomi oldida THE shart: THE Pacific Ocean.

items.question: How long does it live?
items.whyUz: Ma'lumot varaqasidan: about 15 years.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, write fact files about tigers and sea lions. Use the text in Ex. 13 as a model. Decorate your project with pictures from the Photo File section.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng yo'lbarslar va dengiz sherlari haqida ma'lumot varaqlari yozing. 13-mashqdagi matnni namuna sifatida ishlating. Loyihangizni Photo File bo'limidagi rasmlar bilan bezang.
exercises.explanationUz:
13-MASHQ MATNI QOLIPI:
  1) X are mammals.
  2) They ... (bolasi haqida)
  3) They live in ... .
  4) They are about ... tall and weigh about ... .
  5) They have got ... .
  6) They can ... because ... .
  7) They sleep ... and they eat ... .
  8) They live in ... groups.
  9) They live for about ... years.

Berilgan ma'lumotdan foydalaning, qolgan joyni o'z bilimingiz bilan to'ldiring.
Barcha gaplar KO'PLIKDA yoziladi (Tigers ... They ...).

structure.modelEn: They have babies and feed them on milk.
They live in the forests in India.
They have got orange fur with black stripes, four strong legs, sharp claws and a long tail.
structure.noteUz: 41-betdagi rasm va so'zlardan foydalaning: fur, paws, whiskers, black stripes.

structure.modelEn: They can run very fast and they can swim very well, too.
structure.noteUz: Yo'lbars — suzishni yaxshi ko'radigan kam sonli mushuksimonlardan.

structure.modelEn: They sleep during the day and they eat deer and monkeys.
structure.noteUz:
Ma'lumot varaqasidan: during the day; deer and monkeys.
'deer' — ko'plikda ham 'deer'.
Yo'lbars sherdan farqli — yolg'iz yashaydi ('alone' — 42-betdagi koala matnida ham bor).
Dengizda yashasa ham baliq emas — delfin kabi sutemizuvchi.

structure.modelEn: They have babies and feed them on milk.
They live in the Pacific Ocean.
structure.noteUz:
Ma'lumot varaqasidan: the Pacific Ocean.
Okean nomi oldida THE shart: THE Pacific Ocean.

structure.modelEn: They have got thick brown fur, fins and a short tail.

structure.noteUz: 42-betdagi viktorinaning 6-gapi: dengiz sherlari KATTA guruhlarda yashaydi.

groups.explanationUz: 'How' dan keyin sifat qo'yilsa, o'lchov so'raladi.

groups.ruleUz: HOW MUCH va HOW MANY farqi

groups.explanationUz: Bu so'zlar sifat ham, ravish ham bo'ladi — '-ly' QO'SHILMAYDI.
Bu hayvonlarning ko'pligi birligi bilan bir xil.
Okean, dengiz, daryo nomlari oldida THE shart; mamlakat oldida yo'q.

sentencePatterns.introUz: So'roq so'zlari bilan savol tuzish qoliplari.

patterns.formula: So'roq so'zi + DOES + it + fe'l (asos shakli)?
patterns.exampleEn: Where does it live? What does it eat? How long does it live?
patterns.exampleUz: U qayerda yashaydi? U nima yeydi? U qancha yashaydi?
patterns.explanationUz:
'does' bor bo'lsa, asosiy fe'lga -s QO'SHILMAYDI.
'Where does it liveS?' XATO.

patterns.formula: So'roq so'zi + IS/ARE + ega?  ('does' KERAK EMAS)
patterns.exampleEn: What is this animal? How tall is it?
patterns.exampleUz: Bu qanday hayvon? U qancha baland?
patterns.explanationUz: 'be' fe'li o'zi egadan oldinga chiqadi — yordamchi fe'l kerak emas.

patterns.formula: HOW MANY + ot + HAS it GOT?
patterns.exampleEn: How many legs has it got? — Four.
patterns.explanationUz: 'have got' bilan ham 'does' kerak emas: HAS it got.

patterns.exampleEn: Why can it jump very high? — Because its back legs are very strong.
patterns.exampleUz: Nega u baland sakray oladi? — Chunki orqa oyoqlari juda kuchli.

patterns.formula: It weighs about + og'irlik. / It is about + o'lcham + tall.
patterns.exampleEn: It weighs about 200 kilos. They are about two metres tall.
patterns.exampleUz: U taxminan 200 kilo keladi. Ularning bo'yi taxminan ikki metr.
patterns.explanationUz:
Og'irlikda 'be' YO'Q: 'It IS weigh' XATO.
Bo'yda esa 'be' SHART va 'tall' oxirida turadi.

patterns.exampleEn: They can jump very high because their back legs are very strong.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular baland sakray oladi, chunki orqa oyoqlari juda kuchli.
patterns.explanationUz: Bitta gapda ikki qism: natija + sabab.
